responsibility: Implements GCC’s classic value-range propagation pass and its supporting dataflow transformations. It propagates SSA value ranges and equivalences, inserts and later removes ASSERT_EXPR range assertions, folds statements and conditions using inferred ranges, drives array-bounds diagnostics, identifies and applies jump-threading opportunities, simplifies casted conditions, and coordinates loop-closed SSA and scalar-evolution setup/teardown so CFG and SSA are strengthened by range information.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for the tree-vrp pair: it defines the classic VRP pass itself, including assertion insertion/removal, SSA range propagation, folding, array-bounds checking, and jump threading orchestration. Unlike gcc/tree-vrp.h, which only declares shared VRP/range helper interfaces, this file contains the executable pass logic and pass registration.
